craft_notes: Sthāyin: negation-joy (neti). Close: ground (ultimate lands). Rejected: numbering the negations — killed: list breathes; 'Absolute' — killed: THAT kept.

lines: Where no pleasure is, no pain, no grasped, no grasper found,
nor even delusion — THAT is, on ultimate ground.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ yatra na grāhyam grāhakaṃ na ca | na cāsti mūḍhabhāvo 'pi tad asti paramārthataḥ

reads_against.argmap: Where no pleasure, no pain, no graspable, no grasper, not even delusion: THAT is, ultimately.
